Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows normocytic, normochromic anemia (low hemoglobin and hematocrit, normal MCV and MCH), with normal leukocyte and platelet counts. Platelet distribution width is elevated, which may indicate increased platelet size variability, possibly due to reactive or regenerative processes. Further evaluation of anemia etiology (e.g., chronic disease, renal insufficiency, or blood loss) is recommended.
